subject: Request: additional evaluation credits for Clinix bake-off
messages:
From: Bethany Chen <bethany@clinix.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 5 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RFP bake-off — request for evaluation credits

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Clinix is moving quickly on this RFP and we have a head-to-head bake-off scheduled for the week of Sep 20. Legal and procurement will need us to show results on a representative workload.

Quick ask: can Redwood provide an expanded evaluation allocation (additional GPU-hours or credits) so our ML/infra team can run parallel benchmarks against two other vendors? The current trial is helpful but not large enough for full end-to-end tests (multi-streaming, long-context medical records).

What would help us:
- ~120k tokens of sampling + 10 full-document runs (4k–8k tokens each)
- Access to a quantized instance if available for latency comparisons
- A short note confirming data handling for the trial (does Redwood persist logs by default?)

We'd like to include a brief section in our procurement pack outlining the sandbox scope and any expiration dates. Happy to sign an NDA addendum or a short MOU if required.

Best,
Bethany Chen
Director of ML Ops, Clinix Health
bethany@clinix.ai

---
Attachment: Clinix_RFP_Details.pdf (application/pdf)
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Bethany Chen <bethany@clinix.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 6 Sep 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RFP bake-off — request for evaluation credits

Bethany — thanks for the clear ask and for looping me in. Appreciate the details on workload shape.

We can definitely support the bake-off; we typically provide a baseline allotment and then escalate on a case-by-case basis for head-to-heads. Initial offer from my side:
- 150k tokens of evaluation credit + 12 long-document runs on a quantized profile (p50 latency target included)
- 30-day sandbox window starting when you accept the allocation

Two quick items before I lock this in:
1) I need approval from our credits committee for anything beyond 100k tokens for a non-enterprise trial.
2) We require a one-page MOU confirming the trial scope and a note that Clinix will not resell the service. I can send a templated MOU.

I am copying Karthik (pricing) and Ben (partner ops) to expedite approval and confirm any contractual exceptions. If approved, I will attach the proposed allocation summary and DocuSign link.

Next steps:
- Karthik/Ben: can we greenlight 150k tokens + 12 long runs for CLX-2027-0905? If not, what's an approved alternate?
- Bethany: can you confirm the procurement timeline and whether Raj (procurement) should be on the MOU?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Vanessa / Ben — quick take from pricing: we can approve an exception for this one if we attach a small reciprocity clause and require a short MOU. Conditions:

- Approve 150k evaluation tokens + 12 long-document runs (quantized profile)
- Sandbox window = 30 days from allocation start
- One-time, non-renewable unless CLX moves to a paid pilot within 60 days
- Require HubSpot deal update with estimated usage and an MOU signed (I updated deal CLX-2027-0905: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/CLX-2027-0905)

Ben — please confirm we have the capacity reservation for the requested window (we can shift a small block from burst pool). Vanessa: once Ben confirms, I'll sign off and you can send the DocuSign link.
